**Whiskey** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

“A triple-distilled alcoholic beverage made using grain mash. Pre-War versions were created across the United States and beyond. Some wasteland distilleries exist producing post-War versions using corn and razorgrain.”— *Fallout: The Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook*

A thrice-distilled alcoholic beverage brewed pre-War by Uisce Beatha, it can be brewed post-War using corn and Razorgrain. It increases Strength by two while lowering Intelligence by one.

Similar to other fermentable pre-War beverages, whiskey is initially crafted as fermentable whiskey, offering no benefits, inflicting 30 rads, and having a significantly high disease chance of 9% until fully fermented.

Whiskey can be crafted using the brewing and distilling functionality of Wild Appalachia.

- One can reliably be found on a shelf in the Shelters Claim Center

Bottles have a chance to spawn at the following locations:

- Pleasant Valley Ski Resort, on patio tables.
- Sons of Dane Compound
- Top of the World, on the mezzanine level.
- Watoga Station, on a patio table.
- Portside Pub
- The Whitespring Resort, in the general manager room.
